Seagate Technology is seeking an early-career Software Engineer in its Equipment Development Organization. The role supports the design, development, and qualification of software for testing recording heads and media, while developing and maintaining automated test systems and data analysis tools to improve testing performance and reliability.

Responsibilities
This position will support the design, development, and qualification of software used to test recording heads and media
You will work with other software engineers in our department to develop and maintain automated test systems, enhance data analysis tools, and contribute to software solutions that improve the performance and reliability of our testing processes
This role offers hands-on experience with real-world engineering challenges and the opportunity to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams including mechanical, electrical, and firmware engineers
